verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only single-call operations: one request proxied through `/call/`, or one workflow prompt that returns a list. Nothing documents a batch or bulk endpoint, or any CLI or MCP command that applies an operation across many items at once. Getting a list of results from one query is a different thing from performing an operation on many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
